scenes.heading: SCENE 01 - EXT. MAHAWEWA CANAL - DAWN - 1 MINUTE

blocks.text: Heavy rain. Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag. She notices something caught near the canal gate: a body. It is Nimal. She does not scream. She kneels and touches his hand. Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.

blocks.speaker: Aruni
blocks.text: Dinu... oyata meka ahenne nadda?
She calls Dinu. No answer. A distant bus horn mixes with the rain. Cut to black. TITLE: EKAMA SAKSHIYA.

scenes.heading: SCENE 02 - INT. CASH VAN - COLOMBO - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES

blocks.text: Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights. Dinu drives a cash-transfer van. On the dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop. Aruni's voice message plays.

blocks.speaker: Aruni
blocks.text: Nimal thama gedara awilla ne. Oya ada enawa kiyala kiwwa. Mata dan baya hithenawa.
Mudalali calls. Route eka maru karapan. Old Port warehouse ekata yanna. Dinu looks at the red thread around his wrist and turns toward the industrial area.

scenes.heading: SCENE 03 - FLASHBACK - INT. COLOMBO GARAGE - 2 MINUTES

blocks.text: Six hours earlier. Nimal opens a metal box containing photographs, bank documents and the C-17 key. 02

blocks.speaker: Nimal
blocks.text: Mudalali ge salli. Rupiyal million 300. Village project walin gaththa salli.

blocks.speaker: Dinu
blocks.text: Api meka gaththoth apiuth eyala wage wenawa.

blocks.speaker: Nimal
blocks.text: Aruniwa aran yanna oyata oni neda? Eya salli nisa nemei, oyage baya nisa oyawa atharinnawa.
Nimal places the key in Dinu's hand. Dinu looks at it as rain hits the garage roof.

scenes.heading: SCENE 04 - EXT. OLD PORT WAREHOUSE - NIGHT - 2.5 MINUTES

blocks.text: The cash van enters an abandoned warehouse. All lights go off. Dinu turns off the engine and steps into the rain. Masked men surround him. Nimal appears from behind a container.

blocks.speaker: Suren
blocks.text: Driver kenek hero wenna try karanawada?

blocks.speaker: Dinu
blocks.text: Driver kenek thamai. Habai steering eka mage atha.

Suren attacks. Dinu uses the van door, wet concrete and a chain to fight. Nimal tries to escape with a cash bag. Mudalali appears from the darkness and shoots Nimal. The impact is not shown; only Dinu's face and rainwater carrying a red drop.

blocks.speaker: Mudalali
blocks.text: Adare nisa minissu weak wenawa.
Dinu throws the cash bags into the van, reverses through the metal gate and escapes into Colombo traffic.

scenes.heading: SCENE 05 - INT. CASH VAN / COLOMBO ROADS - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES

blocks.text: Dinu opens Nimal's phone. A recording plays: Mudalali ordering Nimal's murder and Inspector Ruwan discussing the village project cash. Dinu understands the whole network.

blocks.speaker: Dinu
blocks.text: Aruni... Nimalwa maruwe Mudalali.

blocks.speaker: Aruni
blocks.text: Ehenam oya? Oyath e kathawema kotasak da?
Dinu looks at the cash bags. His answer is silence.

scenes.heading: SCENE 06 - INT. ARUNI'S HOUSE - MAHAWEWA - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES

blocks.text: Dinu arrives soaked and slightly injured. He places the cash bags on the floor. Aruni slaps him. He gives her the phone. She listens to the murder recording. Her anger becomes controlled determination.

blocks.speaker: Aruni
blocks.text: Me recording eka police ekata giyoth?

blocks.speaker: Dinu
blocks.text: Ruwan police ekka. Evidence eka disappear karai.
Aruni looks toward the village temple loudspeaker. The annual festival is beginning.

scenes.heading: SCENE 07 - EXT. MAHAWEWA TEMPLE GROUND - NIGHT - 1 MINUTE

blocks.text: The village festival is filled with drums, rain and torchlight. Aruni secretly connects Nimal's phone to the temple sound system. Dinu takes the cash bags to the abandoned rice mill.

blocks.speaker: Aruni
blocks.text: Oya yanne salli rakinna da?

blocks.speaker: Dinu
blocks.text: Nae. Oya rakinna.

blocks.speaker: Aruni
blocks.text: Me para api dekdenama ekata yamu.

scenes.heading: SCENE 08 - INT. OLD RICE MILL - NIGHT - 3 MINUTES

blocks.text: Mudalali, Suren and Inspector Ruwan arrive. Vehicle headlights turn Dinu into a silhouette. Mudalali demands the phone and the cash.

blocks.speaker: Mudalali
blocks.text: Oya driver kenek. Decision ganna oyata baha.

blocks.speaker: Dinu
blocks.text: Driver kenek thamai. Habai direction eka ada mama decide karanawa.

Suren attacks. Dinu fights through rice sacks, a metal bar and wet concrete. The fight stays grounded: elbows, body weight, short impacts and one continuous handheld take. Aruni activates the temple loudspeaker. Mudalali and Ruwan's own voices play across the village. Inspector Ruwan tries to cut the power. Aruni blocks him and switches it back on.

blocks.speaker: Aruni
blocks.text: Uniform eka thiyena nisa aththa maranna puluwan kiyala hituwada?
03 Villagers surround the mill. Mudalali raises a gun at Aruni. Headlights blind him. Dinu kicks the weapon away and chooses not to kill him. Police arrive and arrest Mudalali and Ruwan.

scenes.heading: SCENE 09 - EXT. MAHAWEWA BUS STOP - DAWN - 1.5 MINUTES

blocks.text: The cash is handed over as evidence. Dinu is taken away in a police jeep. Aruni ties the red thread back around his wrist.

blocks.speaker: Aruni
blocks.text: Oya enawada?

blocks.speaker: Dinu
blocks.text: Enawa. Habai me para salli nathiwa.
The jeep moves away. Aruni enters the bus. Through the rear window, the village and Colombo road merge into one wet horizon. Final shot: the red thread on Dinu's wrist as rain runs over it.
